text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — high agent/tool-call queue length on hosted-west. metric spike: tool_call_queue_depth=12k, avg_token_lat_p50=420ms, error_rate_tool_invokes=8%. Linked runbook: https://infra.internal/incidents/2119002468

jamie (on-call): ack. I'm looking at the dashboard now. customers seeing timeouts and lots of 5xx from the tool-invoke worker. initial hypothesis: coordinated mass use of function-calls + large structured-json outputs from a few free-tier bots.

ben (runtime eng): seeing repeated large KV cache evictions and sustained GPU busy with many short-lived fncall sessions. The runtime is spending cycles on tool-call setup/teardown + long response serialization. We should throttle calls to the tool service ASAP.

jamie (on-call): suggested immediate mitigations?

ben (runtime eng): propose quick, reversible steps (in order):
1) Apply per-tenant fncall RPS cap: 2 rps for free-tier tenants.
2) Temporarily disable structured JSON output for "hosted" plans on the edge, fall back to plain text/streaming.
3) Route fallback: if tool-call queue > 2k, auto-swap to local-model-variant (smaller but avoids tool invocation).

sarah (eng-sre): +1. We should also bump token-based rate-limits for enterprise customers to avoid regressions. For mitigation: implement rule change at edge route layer, not at runtime so it's faster.

jamie (on-call): I'll apply rule 2 and 1 now. doing staged rollouts: free-tier first, then standard after 5m if looks stable.

deploy-bot: deploy started: policy/edge-mitigations -> canary (1 instance). Commit: 9f2c4b7 by jamie.

ben (runtime eng): config snippet for the edge API (apply via admin console or curl):
```
POST /admin/edge/policies HTTP/1.1
Host: console.internal
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "temp-disable-toolcalls-free-tier-2119002468",
  "conditions": {"plan": "free", "region": "hosted-west"},
  "actions": [
    {"type": "set_header", "header": "X-Allow-Tool-Calls", "value": "false"},
    {"type": "transform_response", "mode": "plaintext-only"},
    {"type": "rate_limit", "target": "fncall", "rps": 2}
  ],
  "expires_at": "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z"
}
```

jamie (on-call): executed the canary. Monitoring logs + `fncall_worker.*` traces.

sarah (eng-sre): seeing queue depth drop to 6k -> 3.2k in 3 minutes. p50 latency down to 310ms. error_rate_tool_invokes down to 3.6%. good trend but still high.

linda (customer-success): any impact on customers we should proactively call out? which tenants are affected?

jamie (on-call): free-tier only so far. enterprise tenants unaffected. I grabbed top 20 tenants by volume — sending list to ops channel. We'll send a brief note to the free-tier status page.

eli (product): recommend a short status page blurb: explain temporary restriction on tool/function-calls for free-tier; no data loss; ETA for revert 2-4 hours pending stability. keep it simple.

jamie (on-call): posting status: "We're temporarily restricting function-calls and structured JSON responses for free-tier customers in hosted-west to reduce latency while we stabilize. No action required. Monitoring closely."

ben (runtime eng): second mitigation ready if queue stays above 2k for 10m: disable tool-call cold-starts (warm pool only) and reduce max-kv-cache-per-session from 512MB to 256MB. I can toggle that via the runtime admin API.

sarah (eng-sre): agree. Also add alert threshold for tool_call_queue_depth to 1.5k after mitigation so we catch regressions faster.

jamie (on-call): executing step 2 (scale down KV caches). done.

deploy-bot: rollout success: policy/edge-mitigations canary -> 100% (completed).

ben (runtime eng): metrics: queue depth at 900, p50 180ms, error_rate_tool_invokes 0.9%. Nice. Looks like the combination worked.

linda (customer-success): drafting comms now. will post to status.redwood.ai and ping onboarding cherrypick customers who had open tickets.

eli (product): long-term follow-ups: quota controls in SDK (client-side backpressure), better guardrails for structured-output sizes, opt-in for heavy fncall features for free-tier. Add to roadmap.

jamie (on-call): operational follow-ups:
- create postmortem if we see recurrence
- add automated mitigations to playbook (edge policy template + runtime toggles)
- schedule retro with growth to understand burst pattern

sarah (eng-sre): handoff incoming. I'm taking over monitoring for next 2h. jamie — anything to call out for my shift?

jamie (on-call): handoff notes:
- mitigation applied: free-tier tool calls disabled at edge; structured JSON -> plaintext fallback; per-tenant fncall rps=2.
- last metrics: queue=900, p50=180ms.
- expect to revert in ~2h if stable for 30m.
- contact list: ben for runtime toggles, linda for comms, eli for product context.

sarah (eng-sre): ack. I'll watch the dashboard and escalate if queue > 1.5k or p50 > 350ms.

jamie (on-call): thanks all — logging this thread in the incident ticket and closing on-call for me. :white_check_mark:
